items.name: dantrolene sodium
items.facts: Updated label for dantrolene sodium (REMEDYREPACK INC.). Boxed warning: Dantrolene sodium has a potential for hepatotoxicity, and should not be used in conditions other than those recommended. Symptomatic hepatitis (fatal and non-fatal) has been reported at various dose levels of the drug. The incidence reported in patients taking up to 400 mg/day is much lower than in those taking doses of 800 mg or more per day. items.summary: RemedyRepack Inc. updated the label for dantrolene sodium with a boxed warning regarding the potential for hepatotoxicity and symptomatic fatal or non-fatal hepatitis.

why_it_matters.text: This boxed warning update highlights critical safety and labeling information regarding dose-dependent hepatotoxicity and serious hepatic injury associated with dantrolene sodium (c10e7eb1-0155-43ff-aa56-8cd468e8e84d@20261008).
